questions.question: Engine 1 or 2 Overspeed - NP Failed High: Sebutkan tindakan darurat lengkap!
questions.answer: 1. Collective - Adjust to maintain NR within limits. If condition persists: 2. Power Lever (affected engine) - Retard to equalize torque, 3. Land as soon as practicable

questions.question: Low RPM Rotor - NP Failed Low: Sebutkan tindakan darurat lengkap!
questions.answer: 1. Collective - Adjust to maintain NR within limits. If condition persists: 2. Power Lever (affected engine) - LOCKOUT & then retard to equalize torque output of both engines. If manual control is not possible: 3. Power Lever (affected engine) - IDLE, 4. Land as soon as practicable

questions.question: Engine Compressor Stall: Sebutkan tindakan darurat lengkap!
questions.answer: 1. Collective - Reduce, 2. Power Lever (affected engine) - Retard. If TGT decreases and there is no further evidence of a stall: 3. Power Lever (affected engine) - FLY. If stall condition recurs: 4. Power Lever (affected engine) - IDLE, 5. Land as soon as practicable

questions.question: Loss of Tail Rotor Thrust in cruise flight - Continued flight possible: Sebutkan 4 langkah darurat!
questions.answer: 1. EMERG HYD Button - Press ON, 2. Airspeed - 100 KTAS minimum (until 10 to 20 ft above Touchdown), 3. Wing Stores Jettison - As appropriate, 4. Power Lever - Retard as necessary (5 to 10 ft above Touchdown)

questions.question: Loss of Tail Rotor Thrust in cruise flight - Continued flight not possible or Low airspeed / Hover: Sebutkan 5 langkah darurat!

questions.question: Main Transmission Input Drive Clutch Failure - In Flight: Tindakan darurat lengkap?
questions.answer: 1. Power Lever (affected engine) - IDLE. If NP below NR (clutch failed to disengage): 2. EMER ENG SHUTDOWN (affected engine), 3. Land as soon as practicable. If NP does not drop below NR: 4. Land as soon as possible, 5. EMERG ENG(S) SHUTDOWN (both engines simultaneously)
acceptedAnswers: 1. Power Lever (affected engine) - IDLE. If NP below NR (clutch failed to disengage): 2. EMER ENG SHUTDOWN (affected engine), 3. Land as soon as practicable. If NP does not drop below NR: 4. Land as soon as possible, 5. EMERG ENG(S) SHUTDOWN (both engines simultaneously)
Power Lever (affected engine) - IDLE, EMER ENG SHUTDOWN (affected engine), Land as soon as practicable, Land as soon as possible, EMERG ENG(S) SHUTDOWN (both engines simultaneously)
questions.sourceDocument: AH-64E Rv. 3.0 EMERGENCY PROCEDURES PRACTICE TEST.pdf

questions.question: Main Transmission Input Drive Clutch Failure - On Ground: Tindakan jika clutch failed to engage vs clutch failed to disengage?
questions.answer: Clutch failed to engage: 1. EMER ENG SHUTDOWN (affected engine only), 2. Or NG is less than 10% (affected engine), 3. Normal engine shutdown - perform. Clutch failed to disengage: 1. EMERG ENG(S) SHUTDOWN (Both Engines Simultaneously)
